name: POST /api/leadflow/payments/:id/refund-request - approval and the expansion freeze
description:
Records a refund request, requires a second party above the threshold, and FREEZES EXPANSION MESSAGING IMMEDIATELY (b6072947-1983-41b2-8b5b-2a7537ab4b46#AC4). The freeze lands before any approval, deliberately: asking somebody to buy more while they are asking for money back is the single most damaging automated message this system could send, and waiting for the decision would leave a window in which the upsell goes out.

requires_approval IS STORED RATHER THAN INFERRED at read time, so a later change to the threshold cannot retroactively make a past refund look unapproved.

A REASON IS MANDATORY. A refund is money leaving under written terms, and the record is what a later reader - finance, a regulator, the customer's lawyer - judges the decision by.

QA: depends on register and login; :id is the gateway charge reference. The amount is above the threshold so the approval branch is the one exercised.

requestBody.reason: Buyer cancelled inside the refund window under the published terms.
